result.reason: The redline appropriately gives the Company 30 days' notice and limits HDI's convenience termination to the end of the then-current term on 90 days' notice. However, subsection (a) remains operative and imposes an uncapped termination payment based on Net Sales, contrary to both the preferred no-penalty position and the fallback cap of three months' fees. It also does not provide the required pro-rata refund of prepaid fees. The margin comment inaccurately states that no termination payment applies. The edits are otherwise targeted and preserve unrelated commercial terms.
